title: Quaest Polls Show Flávio Bolsonaro Leading in São Paulo, Competitive in Minas Gerais
detail: New Quaest polls show Flávio Bolsonaro leading in São Paulo (36% vs Lula 30%) and competitive in Minas Gerais (Lula 35%, Bolsonaro 31%), reinforcing the tightening presidential race as election day approaches.
